notes.notes:
We will release an update ActII in June with 99% certainty (in Steam, release in itc a couple of weeks after the release in Steam! (it's very possible that it's already June 19th!)



[img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GtgKSY2XMAAseF7?format=jpg&name=large"]

сute bonus!

Perhaps many people remember the instructions for reviving the handsome prince from the game!

The instructions are a bit controversial, therefore, we will provide our list of how to please Bastie! (it's a joke, of course, but every joke has a bit of a joke, hehe)

So, how to please Bastie: 
1. Cover him with a blanket when he sleeps (almost always) 
2. To enclose his body with tape so that no one steps on Bastie 
3. Present him blackout curtains 
4. Present him a big cuddle pillow 
5. Be a cuddle pillow 
6. Sing a lullaby 
7. Put all glasses of water away

notes.title: Release News!!!
notes.notes:
Good news!

Our game is ready for release!  (ﾉ◕ヮ◕)ﾉ*:･ﾟ✧

For now, this will be an early access, not the final version. The release will include approximately 5 hours of content, including a demo and the second part of the game. There are 4 planned parts in the game: we plan to release the third and fourth parts during this and next year.

Unfortunately, we are facing some troubles with the platforms. We are actively working on their solution, but we cannot yet say for sure when everything will be ready. We will try to do everything as quickly as possible so that we can share our work with you as soon as possible!
